claims.claim: Let the same smooth unknown drift b and constant symmetric D≻0 govern controlled diffusions on R^d with vanishing boundary flux/integrability, or on a flat torus. For every admissible scalar q for which the integrations are justified, the source derives D:E_{p_i}[q(r)wwᵀ]=E_{p_i}[q(r)δu·w]. Thus full rank of the collected symmetric matrix features M_{ij,q}=E_{p_i}[q(r)wwᵀ], in dimension d(d+1)/2, identifies the constant D uniquely.
claims.interface: All regimes share b and constant state-independent D; intervention fields are known; stationary laws are exact and fully observed for the theorem. Choose f with f′(r)=q(r)/r, multiply the stationary divergence equation by f(r), cancel the J_j term as a gradient against a divergence-free current, and integrate the remaining divergence by parts. The resulting identity is linear in the symmetric entries of D.
